about: House recipes, batch 04 (slice C): written by Claude in a Max-plan session, original, ai-draft. Nutrition is a per-serve estimate kept as data only.

recipes.title: Barbecue Coleslaw with Cider Dressing
recipes.summary: A crunchy, creamy-tangy slaw of cabbage, carrot and apple, built to sit beside pulled pork and ribs.
steps: Toss both cabbages, the carrots and the apple in a large bowl.
Whisk the mayonnaise, vinegar, honey, mustard, celery seeds and pepper until smooth.
Pour the dressing over and toss until everything is evenly coated.
Chill for 30 minutes until the cabbage softens slightly, then toss again.
notes: Best eaten within 2 days.
Squeeze the lime or lemon over just before serving if you like extra tang.

recipes.title: Grilled Corn with Chilli Lime Butter
recipes.summary: Charred corn cobs brushed with a chilli, lime and coriander butter, grilled until the kernels blister.
steps: Mash the butter with the chilli, lime zest, coriander and salt.
Heat a barbecue or grill to medium-high and cook the corn for 12 to 15 minutes, turning, until charred in spots and tender.
Brush generously with the butter and squeeze over the lime juice.
notes: Wrap in foil and grill for 20 minutes if you prefer softer corn.
Keep leftover butter in the fridge for 1 week.

recipes.title: Slow Baked Beans for the Barbecue
recipes.summary: Smoky, sweet baked beans in a thick tomato sauce, simmered low until glossy, with bacon for depth.

items: 2 x 400 g cans cannellini beans, drained

steps: Cook the bacon in a heavy pot for 5 minutes until crisp.
Add the onion and garlic and cook for 5 minutes until soft.
Stir in the beans, tomato sauce, sugar, vinegar, worcestershire sauce, paprika, mustard and water.
Simmer very gently with the lid ajar for 45 minutes until thick and glossy, stirring occasionally.
notes: Food safety: cook the bacon through to 75°C and bring the beans to a steaming heat before serving.
Even better the next day.

recipes.title: Creamy Picnic Macaroni Salad with Celery
recipes.summary: Classic cold macaroni in a tangy creamy dressing with celery, carrot and boiled egg.
steps: Boil the eggs for 9 minutes until the yolks are fully set, cool in cold water, peel and chop.
Cook the macaroni in salted boiling water for 10 minutes until tender, then rinse under cold water and drain.
Whisk the mayonnaise, sour cream, vinegar, mustard and pepper.
Fold the pasta, vegetables, egg and parsley through the dressing.
Chill for 1 hour until cold.
notes: Food safety: boil the eggs until the yolks are fully set and keep the salad chilled below 5°C until serving, especially in hot weather.
Loosen with a splash of milk if the pasta absorbs the dressing.

recipes.title: Charred Zucchini Salad with Mint and Feta
recipes.summary: Smoky grilled zucchini ribbons with mint, lemon and creamy feta, fast on the barbecue.
steps: Brush the zucchini with half the oil and grill on a hot barbecue for 2 to 3 minutes each side until charred and tender.
Toast the pine nuts in a dry pan for 2 minutes until golden.
Arrange the zucchini on a platter and dress with the remaining oil, lemon juice and zest.
Scatter with the feta, mint, pine nuts and chilli flakes.
notes: Cut the zucchini thickly so it does not collapse on the grill.
Serve warm or at room temperature.

recipes.title: Grilled Pineapple with Lime and Chilli
recipes.summary: Sweet, caramelised pineapple rings brushed with lime, chilli and a little honey, served warm.

items: 1 pineapple, peeled and cut into rings

steps: Whisk the lime juice, honey, chilli flakes and oil together.
Brush the pineapple rings and grill on a hot barbecue for 3 to 4 minutes each side until caramelised with dark grill marks.
Brush again with the dressing and scatter with mint.
notes: Excellent beside grilled chicken, pork or fish.
Serve with vanilla yoghurt for dessert.

recipes.title: Beef and Barley Soup
recipes.summary: A thick, comforting soup of beef chuck, pearl barley and root vegetables simmered until the meat falls apart.
steps: Brown the beef in the oil in batches in a large pot for 6 minutes and set aside.
Cook the onion, carrots and celery in the same pot for 6 minutes, then add the garlic and tomato paste.
Return the beef, add the barley, stock, thyme and bay leaf and bring to the boil and stir until the barley is submerged.
Simmer gently for 75 to 90 minutes until the beef is tender and the barley is soft.
Remove the bay leaf and thyme and serve with parsley.
notes: Food safety: cook the beef until tender and the soup reaches a steaming 75°C. Refrigerate leftovers within 2 hours and eat within 3 days.
The soup thickens overnight, so add a splash of stock when reheating.

recipes.title: Lemony Chicken and Rice Soup with Dill
recipes.summary: A bright, comforting soup of chicken, rice and carrot finished with lemon juice and plenty of dill.
steps: Cook the onion, carrots and celery in the oil for 6 minutes until soft, adding the garlic for the last minute.
Add the stock and chicken and simmer gently for 15 minutes until the chicken is cooked through.
Lift out the chicken, shred it and return it to the pot with the rice.
Simmer for 12 minutes until the rice is tender.
Whisk the eggs and lemon juice, slowly whisk in a ladle of hot soup, then stir it all back into the pot off the heat until the soup turns creamy. Add the dill.
notes: Food safety: cook the chicken until no pink remains and it reaches 75°C, and do not boil the soup after adding the eggs. Eat leftovers within 2 days.
Warm gently when reheating so the eggs do not scramble.

recipes.title: Chilean Cazuela Chicken and Pumpkin Stew
recipes.summary: A soupy Chilean chicken stew with pumpkin, potato, corn and rice, served in a deep bowl with coriander.
steps: Brown the drumsticks in the oil in a large pot for 8 minutes and set aside.
Cook the onion, garlic and capsicum for 5 minutes, then stir in the paprika.
Return the chicken, add the stock, potatoes and corn and simmer for 20 minutes.
Add the pumpkin and rice and simmer for 15 minutes until the rice and vegetables are tender.
Scatter with coriander and serve.
notes: Food safety: cook the chicken until the juices run clear and the thickest part reaches 75°C, and refrigerate leftovers within 2 hours.
A drumstick in each bowl is the traditional way to serve.

recipes.title: Venezuelan Sancocho Chicken and Root Vegetable Soup
recipes.summary: A hearty South American soup of chicken, potato, sweet potato and corn with lime and coriander.
steps: Brown the chicken in the oil in a large pot for 8 minutes and set aside.
Cook the onion and garlic for 5 minutes, then stir in the cumin.
Return the chicken, add the water and simmer for 20 minutes.
Add the potatoes, sweet potato and corn and simmer for 20 minutes until the chicken is cooked and the vegetables are tender.
Stir through the coriander and serve with the lime wedges.
notes: Food safety: cook the chicken until it reaches 75°C and the juices run clear, and refrigerate leftovers within 2 hours.
Serve with white rice and avocado.

recipes.title: Winter Lamb Shoulder and Pearl Barley Soup
recipes.summary: A thick, old-fashioned lamb and vegetable broth with barley, swede and leek.
steps: Brown the lamb in the oil in a large pot for 6 minutes.
Add the water and barley, bring to the boil and skim until the scum is gone from the surface.
Simmer for 45 minutes, then add the onion, leek, carrots, swede and thyme.
Simmer for 30 to 40 minutes until the lamb is tender and the barley soft, then stir in the parsley.
notes: Food safety: cook the lamb until tender and at least 75°C throughout, and refrigerate leftovers within 2 hours.
Better the day after, thinned with a little water.

recipes.title: Cock-a-Leekie Soup
recipes.summary: A Scottish chicken and leek soup with a little rice and dried fruit, simple and soothing.
steps: Simmer the chicken, stock and bay leaf in a large pot for 20 minutes until the chicken is cooked through.
Lift out the chicken, shred it and return it to the pot.
Add the leeks, carrot and rice and simmer for 15 minutes until the rice is tender.
Add the sultanas for the last 5 minutes. Season with pepper and finish with parsley.
notes: Food safety: cook the chicken until no pink remains and it reaches 75°C, and eat leftovers within 2 days.
Dried fruit is traditional and add gentle sweetness.

recipes.title: Split Pea and Ham Hock Soup
recipes.summary: A thick, smoky winter soup of green split peas simmered with ham hock until silky.
steps: Cook the onion, carrots and celery in the oil for 6 minutes, adding the garlic for the last minute.
Add the ham hock, split peas, water and bay leaf and bring to the boil, skimming until the foam stops.
Simmer gently for 80 to 90 minutes until the peas break down and the meat is falling off the bone.
Lift out the hock, shred the meat, discard the skin and bone and stir the meat back in.
Season with pepper, tasting for salt as the hock is already salty.
notes: Food safety: simmer until the meat is tender and the soup reaches a steaming 75°C. Eat leftovers within 3 days.
The soup thickens as it stands, so thin with a little water.

recipes.title: Sweet Potato and Black Bean Chilli Soup
recipes.summary: A smoky, thick vegetarian soup of sweet potato and black beans with chipotle and lime.

items: 2 x 400 g cans black beans, drained

steps: Cook the onion in the oil for 5 minutes until soft, adding the garlic, cumin and paprika for the last minute.
Add the sweet potato, beans, tomatoes, stock and chipotle.
Simmer for 25 minutes until the sweet potato is very tender.
Mash roughly with a potato masher to thicken, then stir in the lime juice and coriander.
notes: Top with avocado and sour cream.
Freezes well for 3 months.

recipes.title: Tofu and Mushroom Hot Pot Broth
recipes.summary: A light, savoury broth for the table, with tofu, mushrooms, cabbage and noodles cooked at the table.
steps: Bring the stock, ginger, spring onions, soy sauce and wine to a gentle simmer in a wide pot for 10 minutes.
Add the tofu and mushrooms and simmer for 5 minutes until the mushrooms are tender.
Add the cabbage and noodles and cook for 3 to 4 minutes until the noodles are soft and the cabbage wilted.
Drizzle with the sesame oil and serve straight from the pot.
notes: Add thinly sliced beef or fish balls for non-vegetarian hot pot, cooking them until no pink remains.
Dip cooked pieces in soy sauce and chilli.

recipes.title: Sichuan Style Hot Pot Soup
recipes.summary: A numbing, spicy broth with chilli bean paste and Sichuan pepper, loaded with vegetables and tofu.
steps: Heat the oil in a pot and fry the chilli bean paste, peppercorns, ginger and garlic for 2 minutes until the oil turns red and fragrant.
Pour in the stock and simmer for 15 minutes.
Add the carrot and tofu and cook for 5 minutes until tender.
Add the mushrooms and bok choy and cook for 2 minutes until just wilted.
Scatter with spring onions.
notes: Reduce the chilli bean paste for less heat.
Fish out the peppercorns before eating if you prefer.

recipes.title: Tomato Egg Drop Soup
recipes.summary: A quick Chinese style soup of ripe tomato and ribbons of egg in a gingery broth.
steps: Fry the tomatoes and ginger in the oil for 4 minutes until soft and pulpy.
Add the stock, soy sauce and sugar and simmer for 5 minutes.
Mix the cornflour with the water, stir into the soup and cook for 1 minute until slightly thickened.
Slowly pour in the eggs in a thin stream, stirring gently until they form ribbons and are set.
Finish with spring onions and sesame oil.
notes: Food safety: cook the egg until fully set and the soup steaming at 75°C, especially for pregnant women, older people and young children.
Ripe tomatoes give the best flavour.

recipes.title: Barbecue Potato Salad with Bacon and Chives
recipes.summary: A warm-to-cold potato salad with crisp bacon, a creamy mustard dressing and lots of chives.
steps: Boil the potatoes in salted water for 12 to 15 minutes until just tender, then drain and cool for 10 minutes.
Boil the eggs for 9 minutes until the yolks are fully set, then peel and chop. Fry the bacon for 6 minutes until crisp.
Whisk the mayonnaise, sour cream, mustard, vinegar and pepper.
Fold the potatoes, bacon, eggs, celery and half the chives through the dressing.
Chill for 30 minutes until cold and top with the remaining chives.
notes: Food safety: boil the eggs until the yolks are set, cook the bacon through to 75°C and keep the salad chilled below 5°C until serving.
Dress the potatoes while still slightly warm for more flavour.

recipes.title: Grilled Halloumi and Watermelon Salad
recipes.summary: Salty golden halloumi, juicy watermelon, mint and rocket with a lime dressing, ideal for summer barbecues.
steps: Grill the halloumi on a hot barbecue for 2 to 3 minutes each side until golden with dark grill marks.
Toss the watermelon, rocket and mint on a platter.
Whisk the lime juice, oil and pepper, then drizzle over.
Top with the warm halloumi and pepitas.
notes: Halloumi is salty, so no extra salt is needed.
Serve straight away while the cheese is warm.

recipes.title: Smoky Eggplant Dip from the Barbecue
recipes.summary: Eggplants charred whole on the grill, then mashed with tahini, garlic and lemon for a smoky dip.
steps: Grill the whole eggplants over a hot barbecue for 25 to 30 minutes, turning, until the skins blacken and the flesh collapses.
Cool slightly, then scoop out the soft flesh and drain in a sieve for 10 minutes.
Mash the flesh with the tahini, garlic, lemon juice and salt until creamy.
Transfer to a bowl, drizzle with the oil and top with parsley and paprika.
notes: Keeps for 4 days in the fridge.
Serve with warm flatbread.

recipes.title: Barbecued Pear Salad with Ricotta and Walnuts
recipes.summary: Caramelised pears with peppery rocket, creamy ricotta and a balsamic drizzle.
steps: Brush the pears with half the oil and grill cut-side down for 3 to 4 minutes until caramelised with grill marks.
Slice the pears and arrange over the rocket.
Dot with the ricotta and scatter with the walnuts.
Whisk the remaining oil, vinegar, honey and pepper and drizzle over.
notes: Use firm-ripe pears that hold their shape on the grill.
Peaches also work in summer.

recipes.title: Barbecue Broccolini with Garlic, Lemon and Almonds
recipes.summary: Blistered broccolini tossed with garlic, lemon and chilli flakes, a quick grilled side.
steps: Blanch the broccolini in boiling water for 1 minute, then drain and dry well.
Toss with half the oil and grill on a hot barbecue for 3 to 4 minutes until charred and tender.
Warm the garlic in the remaining oil for 1 minute until fragrant.
Toss the broccolini with the garlic oil, lemon juice and zest, chilli flakes, almonds and salt.
notes: Do not let the garlic brown or it turns bitter.
Good with grilled fish or steak.

recipes.title: Grilled Capsicum and White Bean Salad
recipes.summary: Charred capsicum with creamy cannellini beans, red onion, parsley and a sharp red wine dressing.

items: 2 x 400 g cans cannellini beans, drained

steps: Grill the capsicums skin-side up on a hot barbecue for 10 to 12 minutes until blackened, then cover and rest for 10 minutes.
Peel off the skins and slice the flesh.
Whisk the oil, vinegar, garlic and salt.
Toss the capsicum, beans, onion and parsley with the dressing.
notes: Keeps for 3 days in the fridge and improves overnight.
Serve with grilled sausages or lamb.

recipes.title: Barbecue Baked Potatoes with Sour Cream and Chives
recipes.summary: Foil-wrapped potatoes cooked in the coals until fluffy, split and loaded with sour cream and chives.
steps: Prick the potatoes, rub with the oil and salt, and wrap each tightly in foil.
Cook on a covered barbecue or in the coals for 50 to 60 minutes, turning once, until a skewer slides in easily.
Split each potato and fluff the flesh with a fork.
Add butter, sour cream, cheddar and chives.
notes: Cook on indirect heat so the skins do not burn.
Try adding crisp bacon pieces for a loaded version.
